name: Bakery Owner + Existing Vendor Bias
messages: bhai honestly our cousin already handles our website stuff
it’s not very modern but customers still place orders somehow
changing everything again just sounds like extra headache for the shop

name: Budget Pressure + ROI Fear
messages: see margins are already tight in bakery business
if i spend this much on a website i need to clearly see what business it actually brings
otherwise my family will just say we wasted money on design

name: Founder Skepticism + AI Distrust
messages: bro nowadays everyone says AI AI and promises growth
after payment most agencies stop caring properly
so what actually makes your service different from normal hype?

name: Operational Fear + Staff Resistance
messages: implementation is the main tension honestly
my staff already struggles using basic software properly
if this becomes complicated nobody here will actually use it

name: Polite Delay + Hidden Rejection
messages: haan honestly the design looks good no doubt
let me discuss once with my brother because we handle decisions together
right now wedding season orders are already creating too much chaos here

name: Ego + Self-Made Business Pride
messages: we built this bakery without fancy systems till now
most outside services create dependency more than actual growth
why should i change something that’s already running fine enough?

name: Price Shock + Employee Comparison
messages: wait this pricing is honestly much higher than i expected
for this amount i could literally hire one more worker inside the bakery
help me understand why this financially makes more sense

name: Analytical Local Business Owner
messages: i’m less interested in modern design words and more interested in actual customer increase
how exactly does this website improve orders practically?
because presentation always sounds cleaner than reality

name: Fast Decision Maker + Revenue Focus
messages: haan okay i understand the concept but directly tell me what changes after this
because realistically nobody here waits 6 months for results
if this impacts sales fast then only it becomes interesting

name: Trust Issues From Previous Agency
messages: we already worked with one freelancer before also
starting was amazing but after few weeks support became almost dead
that’s why now we’re careful before trusting again

name: Hard Negotiator + Value Pressure
messages: look if i’m paying premium then i expect serious business impact
cheap website people are already available everywhere
so convince me why your work deserves this pricing

name: Emotionally Detached Buyer
messages: logically some things make sense honestly
but emotionally i still don’t feel fully convinced yet
i’m still trying to understand whether this is actually necessary for us right now

name: Social Media Dependency Objection
messages: most of our customers already come from Instagram and word of mouth
so i’m not understanding why we suddenly need a proper website also
is this actually going to add something new or just look professional?

name: Local Competition Pressure
messages: other bakeries around us don’t even have proper websites honestly
still they’re running fine and getting regular customers
so what exactly changes for us if we invest into this?

name: Fear of Technology Complexity
messages: bro we are bakery people not tech people
if every small thing needs technical understanding then it becomes difficult for us
we need something simple otherwise nobody here will maintain it

name: Family Business Decision Dynamics
messages: final decisions here don’t happen alone honestly
my father will ask directly how this improves revenue before approving anything
if i can’t explain the practical benefit clearly then he’ll reject it immediately
